question: Should OpenClaw add native HEARTBEAT.md per-task model hints, keep heartbeat routing whole-turn/plugin-owned, or fold the need into the scheduled job model-override track?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct contract affects public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, provider/model precedence, task batching, and session-state semantics.

options.title: Keep whole-turn/plugin routing
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are model-routed as one turn via heartbeat.model or before_model_resolve unless a missing generic seam is proven.

options.title: Add HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Define task-level model/provider fields and split due tasks by effective model while preserving timestamp and shared-session behavior.

options.title: Fold into cron/job routing
options.body: Make the open cron model-override issue the canonical scheduled automation path and avoid a heartbeat-specific syntax for now.

recommendation.title: Keep whole-turn/plugin routing
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are model-routed as one turn via heartbeat.model or before_model_resolve unless a missing generic seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent heartbeat/runtime/config history for routing an implementation-shape decision on this surface.
